# Pi Remote Web LLM instructions

Pi Remote Web is a localhost multi-session browser UI for Pi. Pi owns AgentSession,
models, auth, tools, skills, extensions, and session JSONL files. Pi Remote Web is a
thin Svelte client plus Node http/SSE hub over @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.

## Install / use facts

```bash
pi install ~/Projects/pi-remote-web
```

Inside pi:

```text
/remote-web                          # live-attach current session + open browser
/remote-web <sessionId>              # open session id/path
/remote-web open <sessionId> 4000    # custom port
/remote-web stop                     # stop host
```

Localhost only: 127.0.0.1. Do not add public bind/auth unless explicitly asked.
No Express/socket.io/tRPC; use node:http and SSE.

## Repository map

```text
extensions/web.ts        # pi /remote-web command, in-process attach, port takeover
extensions/remote.ts     # auto-register interactive Pi with persistent daemon
remote/                  # NDJSON protocol, reconnecting client, session ownership locks
server/http.js           # REST + static dist + SSE endpoint
server/remote-broker.js  # persistent daemon's Unix-socket session registry
server/hub.js            # multi-session AgentSession lifecycle (red zone)
server/sse-protocol.js   # SSE replay/snapshot policy (red zone)
server/customization.js  # local config + safe asset loading
web/src/main.ts          # Svelte bootstrap
web/src/App.svelte       # routing/open session shell
web/src/lib/api.ts       # browser API client
web/src/lib/chat-stream.ts # client stream merge (red zone)
web/src/lib/components/  # UI chrome/components
web/src/lib/plugins/     # message plugin registry
web/src/lib/kit/         # vendored UI kit
web/src/lib/customization.ts # applies local config to UI
web/src/lib/feedback.ts  # sound/reduced-motion gating
dist/                    # built web UI shipped by package
docs/                    # TanStack Start human landing page
```

## Commands

```bash
npm test                 # server + stream contracts
npm run check            # Svelte/TypeScript
npm run build            # rebuild package-root dist/
npm run check:docs       # docs TypeScript check
```

If web/ changes and the package should ship it, run `npm run build`.

## Safe change boundaries

Prefer the highest zone that works.

### Green: intended customization

- `web/src/lib/plugins/` message renderers
- Theme tokens / CSS variables / FOUC-safe theme edits
- Presentation-only UI chrome in `web/src/lib/components/*`
- Docs / README / llms.txt
- Client wrappers for existing API routes in `web/src/lib/api.ts`

### Yellow: clear need, small diff

- New REST capability: `hub -> http.js -> api.ts -> UI`
- `CommandPalette.svelte`: add one command/action, do not restructure
- `ChatPanel.svelte`, `ComposerPlus.svelte`: careful, streaming UX
- `App.svelte`, `SessionList.svelte`: routing/sidebar semantics
- One vendored kit component if already used

### Red: bugfix only + tests

- `server/hub.js` lifecycle, locks, prompt queues, dispose/attach
- `server/sse-protocol.js` and SSE branch in `server/http.js`
- `web/src/lib/chat-stream.ts` seq gate/snapshot/message merge
- Trust boundary, localhost/CORS assumptions

## Local customization contract

Config locations, merge order:

1. Built-in defaults
2. `~/.pi/agent/pi-remote-web/config.json`
3. `.pi/pi-remote-web/config.json` only after pi trusts the project

Supported v1 keys:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "appearance": {
    "sidebarWidth": 320,
    "rightSidebarWidth": 440,
    "density": "compact"
  },
  "motion": { "intensity": "subtle" },
  "sound": {
    "enabled": true,
    "volume": 0.2,
    "turnComplete": "./sounds/complete.ogg"
  },
  "theme": {
    "accent": "#7c6cff",
    "radius": "10px"
  }
}
```

Validation rules:

- `appearance.sidebarWidth`: number 200..600
- `appearance.rightSidebarWidth`: number 240..720
- `appearance.density`: compact | comfortable | spacious
- `motion.intensity`: none | subtle | full; prefers-reduced-motion wins
- `sound.enabled`: boolean
- `sound.volume`: number 0..1
- `sound.turnComplete`: relative local path only
- `theme.accent`: #rrggbb or empty
- `theme.radius`: px or rem

Assets are served only from resolved customization directories. Reject remote
URLs and `..` traversal. Browser-playable audio: .ogg/.mp3/.wav.

## How to customize code

- Custom message rendering: register in `web/src/lib/plugins/registry.ts` via a
  small plugin file imported by bootstrap/App. Match narrowly by role/customType.
- Theme/UI tokens: prefer CSS variables in `web/src/app.css` or kit tokens.
- UI chrome: edit the smallest component that owns the visible element.
- New backend capability: add hub method, route in `server/http.js`, typed helper
  in `web/src/lib/api.ts`, then minimal UI.

## Anti-patterns

- Replacing SSE with WebSockets
- Adding Express, socket.io, tRPC, or a second server framework
- Duplicating pi model/auth/settings config
- Runtime arbitrary Svelte/JS loading for user config
- Public plugin manifests/marketplace scaffolding
- Deep `MessageBubble` edits when a message plugin works
- Wide refactors of hub/chat-stream while adding UI features

## Output expectation for coding agents

Make the smallest working diff. Reuse existing code before adding abstractions.
For non-trivial logic, add or update one focused test. Keep explanations short
and list files changed plus checks run.
